# Quick Start Guidesvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml)

This guide provides hands-on examples for the two fundamental Contexter workflows: **packaging a directory into a context file** and **reconstructing a project from a context file**. These examples demonstrate the most common use cases and will get you productive immediately after installation.

For installation instructions, see [Installation](/ray0404/Contexter/2.1-installation). For a comprehensive list of all available commands, see [Command Overview](/ray0404/Contexter/2.3-command-overview). For conceptual background on context files and the packaging model, see [Context Files](/ray0404/Contexter/3.1-context-files) and [Packaging and Reconstruction](/ray0404/Contexter/3.2-packaging-and-reconstruction).

---

## Prerequisitessvg image

Before starting, ensure:

- Contexter is installed via `pip install .` (see [Installation](/ray0404/Contexter/2.1-installation))
- You have a test project directory to practice with, or can create one
- All commands are available in your shell (test with `buildcontext --help`)

---

## Basic Packaging Examplesvg image

### Creating Your First Context Filesvg image

The `buildcontext` command converts any directory structure into a single Markdown file. This is the core operation that aggregates all project files into a portable format.

**What Happens:**

The command executes [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py73](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L73-L73) which:

1. Processes the directory recursively ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L49))
2. Generates a file tree structure ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py24-25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L24-L25))
3. Extracts each file's content with syntax highlighting ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py40-46](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L40-L46))
4. Skips binary files automatically ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36-39](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L39))
5. Applies default exclusion patterns from [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py) (e.g., `__pycache__`, `.git`, `node_modules`)

### Understanding the Context File Formatsvg image

Open `my_app_context.md` to see the structure:

my\_sample\_app/
├── README.md
├── main.py
└── src/
└── utils.py

```px-2
--- FILE: my_sample_app/README.md ---

````markdown
# My Sample App
```

--- FILE: my\_sample\_app/main.py ---

--- FILE: my\_sample\_app/src/utils.py ---

```px-2
The format uses:
- `--- DIRECTORY STRUCTURE: <name> ---` headers (<FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L25-L25" min=25  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>)
- `--- FILE: <path> ---` markers (<FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L44-L44" min=44  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>)
- Code fences with language tags (<FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L45-L45" min=45  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>)
- `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): <path> ---` for binary files (<FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L38-L38" min=38  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>)

For complete format specifications, see [Markdown Context Format](#7.1).

**Sources:** <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L25-L25" min=25  file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef> <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L44-L45" min=44 max=45 file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>

## Basic Reconstruction Example

### Rebuilding a Project from Context

The `reconstructor` command performs the inverse operation: converting a context file back into a directory structure with individual files.

**Command Structure:**
```bash
reconstructor <input_context.md> <output_directory>
```

**Example Workflow:**

**What Happens:**

The command executes [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)reconstructor.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/reconstructor.py) which:

1. Parses the Markdown file using `parse_markdown_context()` from [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py)
2. Extracts file paths and contents from `--- FILE: <path> ---` markers
3. Creates the directory structure (`./reconstructed_app/my_sample_app/`)
4. Writes each file with original content
5. Preserves relative paths exactly as they appeared

**Process Visualization:**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L25-L25) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)reconstructor.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/reconstructor.py)

## Round-Trip Verificationsvg image

A key feature of Contexter is **lossless round-trip conversion** for text files. You can verify this with a complete cycle:

**Expected Result:** No differences for text content. The only variations would be:

- Ordering of files (if not deterministically sorted)
- Binary file representations (marked as skipped, not content-compared)

## Common Command Patternssvg image

### Pattern 1: Packaging with Exclusionssvg image

Exclude specific files or patterns during packaging:

The `--exclude` flag adds patterns to the default exclusion list from [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py) (which already excludes `.git`, `__pycache__`, `node_modules`, etc.).

**Exclusion Processing:**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L54-L54) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L57-L57)

---

### Pattern 2: Packaging Multiple Pathssvg image

Include multiple directories or files in a single context:

The command processes each path in order ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py61-69](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L61-L69)), avoiding duplicates via a `processed_files` set ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-17](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L17)).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py61-69](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L61-L69)

---

### Pattern 3: Reconstructing to a New Locationsvg image

Specify any output directory for reconstruction:

The reconstructor creates the output directory if it doesn't exist and preserves the original project's root directory name as a subdirectory.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)reconstructor.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/reconstructor.py)

---

## Quick Reference Tablesvg image

| Task | Command | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Package a directory | `buildcontext <out.md> <dir>` | `buildcontext app.md ./my_app` |
| Package with exclusions | `buildcontext <out.md> <dir> --exclude <pattern>` | `buildcontext app.md ./src --exclude "*.log"` |
| Package multiple paths | `buildcontext <out.md> <path1> <path2> ...` | `buildcontext all.md ./src ./docs` |
| Reconstruct to directory | `reconstructor <in.md> <outdir>` | `reconstructor app.md ./rebuild` |
| View command help | `<command> --help` | `buildcontext --help` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L36) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py51-56](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L51-L56)

---

## Next Stepssvg image

After mastering these basic workflows, explore:

- **AI Integration:** Use `sanitizecontext` to fix AI-generated code before reconstruction (see [AI Integration Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.2-ai-integration-workflow))
- **Version Management:** Create and apply patches with `updatecontext` and `updater` (see [Version Control with Patches](/ray0404/Contexter/4.3-version-control-with-patches))
- **Format Conversion:** Convert between Markdown and HTML context files (see [Format Conversion Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.4-format-conversion-workflow))
- **HTML Contexts:** Use `buildcontexthtml` for HTML-formatted output (see [buildcontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.2-buildcontexthtml))
- **Advanced Updates:** Try `smartupdate` for rsync-based high-performance updates (see [smartupdate](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate))

For complete command documentation, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md9-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L9-L36)
